name: Xiaomi Mi Wireless Mouse
notes: 136-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Xiaomi Mi Wireless Mouse, from Linux HID test data for the device: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/24a19b953e2a3d0ea5a8c4951a0ab8f32720c907/tools/testing/selftests/hid/tests/test_mouse.py#L253-L321. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
